summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan for Focus Elite:
1. Modern professional dark-theme adaptive app icon generation and configuration.
2. Comprehensive Calisthenics & Home-Accessible Exercise database (111+ bodyweight exercises augmented with household item exercises like backpack squats, towel crunches/rows, chair dips, doorframe rows).
3. Elite, non-bulky workout logger styled like premier fitness apps (compact set-by-set table, previous log comparison, inline quick steppers, integrated rest timer).
4. Streamlined exercise catalogue with responsive muscle & equipment chips and instant search.
5. Persistent local workout history, session volume metrics, and streak tracking via Room database.
